failures.sentence: Both are looking at the same 3.25% neutral estimate and the same unemployment forecast of 4.1%, a tenth below the Fed's own estimate of the natural rate [c1076].

UBS is unmoved, keeping its 2027 AI capex forecast at $1.2 trillion, a 33% rise from $900 billion this year, and pointing at chip stocks trading near 21 times forward earnings against 33 times in June
